items.title: Giraffe Designs: The Ten-Foot Smoke Escape, Rotten Toilets, and Mahishasur Mantri
items.core_theme: Workplace alienation: sneaking past a micromanaging boss for a 13-rupee cigarette, decaying office bathrooms, and endless marketing briefs
items.core_spark: Sharmita tiptoeing past Mr. Achyutan's cabin at Giraffe Designs LLC; freezing in ballet poses when someone sneezes; getting saddled with a 3-day Mahishasur pitch brief; escaping outside to face a buzzing phone with 7 unread messages from dad
items.next_action: Connect directly as an opening chapter or scene prelude to The Runaway Escape Arc

harvest_snippets.snippet: > "The name Giraffe was a personal insight from Mr. Achyutan: '...it signifies the ability to look over barriers.' He was proud of that analogy... A pungent smell invaded her nose like invisible little Roman soldiers... She had spent 2 years 5 months and 21 days out of her 2 years 5 months and 23 days in the company avoiding coming here... 'Take these pages... Research the company. The pitch is Monday next week. We don't want any mistakes. Do we?'" (May 28, 2018)

items.title: The Shaadi Hogwarts: Matrimonial Extremism, Grocery Bride-Hunting, and Post-25 Guilt
items.core_theme: Stand-up comedy premise: middle-class Indian maternal desperation around marriage, grocery bargaining for brides, and an elite academy for matrimonial pressure
items.core_spark: Mothers bargaining for brides like fresh produce; watching Game of Thrones and praising Sansa for marrying early; imagining a Hogwarts-style academy for moms teaching emotional blackmail, where divorce is Voldemort and Dumbledore invests in Shaadi.com
items.next_action: Synthesize with MOC_03 as a structured stand-up comedy and satire set

harvest_snippets.snippet: > "Marriages are like democracy, everybody has a say, and your vote doesn't count... She goes to buy groceries and starts fishing for brides for her son. She'll ask about height and weight, she'll ask about freshness... What would a school for mothers look like? An old aunty comes with a belan and tells mom she has been accepted to Hogwarts... Professor Dumbledore: why is he so great? He has gotten millions of people married. He is the investor in shaadi.com." (May 29, 2018)

[ ] Add the 'Marriages are like democracy' line to [[Voice_and_Dialogue_Scraps]]

items.title: The Maggi-Weed Odyssey: Bombay Lockdowns, Auto-Cannibal Zombies, and Dehradun
items.core_theme: Dystopian dark-comedy adventure: escaping a zombie-infested Mumbai to rescue mother in Dehradun with a stash of instant noodles and weed
items.core_spark: A pandemic where news anchors parrot propaganda while infected humans eat their own organs; a protagonist surviving on Maggi who flees across India accompanied by a stoner girl, two armed survivors, and a movie star; featuring a tragic zombie who doesn't realize she has turned
items.next_action: Develop into a high-concept satirical horror-comedy outline in Stories_In_Progress

harvest_snippets.snippet: > "Viral Zombie infection. If the zombie does not eat human flesh, it will eat its own body from the inside... A zombie's POV: This Zombie hasn't fully converted. She thinks she is still human. She hides from other zombies. At the end she is trapped in between other zombies. The drama builds but they ignore her. She is confused as to why. She finds out that she has turned into a zombie as well." (May 30, 2018)

items.title: The Blue Tick Illusion: Balcony Mauritius, Vegan Lies, and the 100-Rupee Poster
items.core_theme: Contemporary romantic satire on influencer culture: staging fake luxury travel with cheap printed posters, chasing algorithmic validation, and performative love
items.core_spark: Sameer staging Mauritius beach shots on a windy Bangalore balcony while yelling at a boy holding a poster; falling in love with agency influencer Disha who eats chicken parathas off-camera while preaching veganism; losing authentic love to obtain a verified blue tick
items.next_action: Refine into a feature-length screenplay or episodic pilot in Stories_In_Progress

harvest_snippets.snippet: > "The boy turns around, looks straight at the camera and raises his bottle to say cheers... Sameer shouts at another boy holding the poster of a sunset: 'Abey dhang se pakad na. Ud kyun raha hai.'... '100 rupaye me jaan le lo'... Sameer snaps back, 'To kya ghar tere naam kar dun... Ispe hashtag mauritius daalna hai. Yaad rakhna.'" (May 30, 2018)

> "'Sir hame pata hai ki aap chahen to aaj hi dono jagah ja sakte hain. Right?... Aap apne followers ko bewakoof bana sakte hain. Hame thodi na... Hame to bas aapke followers se matlab hai. Is hafte dono jagah chale jayiyega.'" (May 30, 2018)
